static_review.io4_probe: Current version completes metadata enumeration, then asserts exactly one serial-matched IO4 UsagePage1/Usage4/64B target before any actual input read; a single target is reopened and serial rechecked before one GetInputReport. This is static review only.

recommendation: Keep IO4 and all additional energizing tests stopped after the reported 5V-GND short unless a separate physical inspection and explicit user decision establish a safe continuation. Preserve all earlier results with their scope; do not treat read-only CDC success as electrical clearance.
